name: Sentinel Thenysil
summary: Sentinel Tara Thenysil is a night elf sentinel stationed in Astranaar within the ancient forest of Ashenvale. Vigilant over the surrounding wilderness, she keeps close tabs on military operations in the region and coordinates scouts watching neighboring territories. Her attention is particularly focused on allied movements pushing south into the contested Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: Watching the Borders
sections.body: From her post in the fortified settlement of Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps secure Ashenvale against growing hostility. Night elf holdings throughout the region face relentless encroachment, making communications between distant outposts vital. While much of the local garrison focuses directly on defending the forest road, Thenysil directs Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale's borders to ensure distant allies remain supported.

sections.title: Ties to Stonetalon
sections.body: Thenysil maintains a close personal and military friendship with Kaela Shadowspear, an operative deployed south into the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. Learning that Kaela was dispatched alongside an eccentric gnome mage, Thenysil considered the unorthodox pairing an unmistakable sign of serious trouble brewing in the peaks. Wary of what dangers her comrade might face, she recruits capable adventurers to journey south, deliver support, and report on the unfolding mission.

sections.title: Audience in the Canopy
sections.body: When scouts return from Stonetalon with word of successful strikes against the defiling Venture Company, Thenysil ensures their deeds do not go unnoticed. Recognizing that repelling mechanized exploitation in the mountains protects the sanctity of all neighboring wilds, she grants reliable heroes a formal commendation. Rather than hoarding credit in Astranaar, she directs them up to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus for a personal reception before High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

faq.q: Where can Sentinel Thenysil be found?
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil is stationed in Astranaar, the primary night elf stronghold located along the central road in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Thenysil send travelers to Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Her friend, Kaela Shadowspear, was deployed to Stonetalon alongside a gnome mage. Viewing that unusual assignment as an omen of dangerous trouble, Thenysil sends dependable adventurers to reinforce Kaela's mission.
Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf scout and a close friend of Sentinel Thenysil. She is stationed in the Stonetalon Mountains investigating threats to the land.

faq.q: What threats are being fought in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Beyond skirmishes with local adversaries, the Venture Company has established invasive, destructive industrial operations in the Stonetalon Mountains, strip-mining and deforesting the landscape.

faq.q: Why does Thenysil send adventurers to Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: After adventurers successfully assist Kaela Shadowspear in halting the Venture Company's schemes in Stonetalon, Thenysil sends them to Darnassus so that High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind can personally acknowledge their service to the night elves.

faq.q: What is Sentinel Thenysil's role in Astranaar?
faq.answer: She serves as a sentinel coordinator in Astranaar, helping organize regional intelligence, monitor borders, and dispatch reliable Alliance recruits to support distant garrisons.

angles.text: Thenysil represents the diligent watch of the Sentinels, working tirelessly to shield Kalimdor's sacred groves and keep allied operatives safe across border frontiers.
Serving as an early bridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains, Thenysil provides Alliance adventurers an opportunity to earn direct favor with the leadership in Darnassus.
Thenysil finds the deployment of an alliance gnome mage to Stonetalon to be an unusual and alarming sign, highlighting how curious night elves still find their diminutive allies.
